newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 14.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast's young farmers to benefit from 20 billion CFA fund set up with Swiss help to pay for training and other incentives
- Ivory Coast tax officers threaten unlimited strike in dispute over who should be responsible for collecting taxes; leave time for government to try to find a solution

- Government communique recalls that all mini-buses and coaches carrying more than nine passengers must have speed limiters and says police and paramilitary gendarmes are on look out for those who do not comply.
- Inquiry under way into why Ghana Airways DC9, with 104 people on board, crash landed in driving rain at Abidjan's international airport; three people were slightly hurt in the crash.
